en.title: Organization Profile Setup
en.excerpt: A friendly guide to setting up your archery club or organization profile, contact channels, payout bank account, and public branding.
en.content:
1. Why Complete Your Club Profile?

Completing your organization profile gives your club immediate credibility among athletes and parents. It ensures that when archers register for your championships or search for local training ranges, they find verified information, clear contact hotlines, and official club credentials.

2. Club Identity, Logo & Bio

To set up your club's core branding:

  1. Log in as an organizer and navigate to Organizer Dashboard > Organization Profile (/dashboard/organizer/profile).
  2. On the General Info tab, update the following fields:
    • Club Logo & Header Banner: Upload high-resolution images (PNG or JPG). Your logo will appear on live scoreboards, match sheets, and certificates.
    • Organization Name: Your official club, academy, or regional federation name.
    • Custom URL Slug: Create a short, memorable web address for your public club profile (e.g., archeris.net/clubs/your-club).
    • Country & Domicile City: Geographic location for regional event filtering.
    • SK / Registration Number: (Optional) Official federation affiliation or legal government registry number.
    • About Organization: A brief story about your club, founding year, coaching philosophy, or training programs.
  3. Click Save Changes to store your updates.

3. Contact Hotline & Practice Range Location

Athletes and coaches often need to ask questions about equipment rules, match schedules, or practice sessions. Setting up clear contact channels prevents confusion on tournament day:

  • WhatsApp / Phone Hotline: Direct number for committee assistance. This appears as a one-tap contact button on public event pages.
  • Official Support Email: For formal inquiries and federation communications.
  • Social Media Links: Add your Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, or YouTube links to grow your community.
  • Range Address & Map Coordinates: Pinpoint your home archery range or headquarters so visiting archers can easily find the venue.

4. Bank Account for Tournament Revenue

Archeris processes registration payments directly from participants via QRIS, Virtual Accounts, and Credit Cards. To receive your ticket sales revenue:

  1. Open the Bank Account tab.
  2. Select your Bank Name (e.g., BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI).
  3. Enter the Account Number and exact Account Holder Name.
  4. Save your changes. Once your tournament registration concludes, you can request an instant payout directly from your Revenue & Payouts menu.

5. Public Club Page & Verification

Make sure to toggle Public Profile Visibility to active. This activates your public club showcase where visitors can browse your upcoming tournaments, read club news, view registered coaches, and connect directly with your team!
